title: Visual Studio Code Review: Good vs Bad | IDE Guide
voiceover_script: Thinking about trying Visual Studio Code? Let's break down the good, the bad, and who it's actually best for in 60 seconds! Visual Studio Code is a powerful general purpose code editor. On the positive side, Massive extension ecosystem with thousands of plugins and themes.; Exceptional language support with LSP (Language Server Protocol).. However, keep in mind: Can consume significant memory with many active extensions.; Microsoft telemetry enabled by default (can be disabled or avoided with VSCodium).. Pricing structure is Free / Open Source (Core). Our verdict: Developers seeking a highly customizable, fast, all-purpose editor with huge ecosystem support..
